newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Telebras eyes rate hike - paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Telebras eyes rate hike - paper.

text.p: Brazil's state telephone company Telebras said it was preparing another rate hike that would increase basic service costs by 200 percent, O Globo said.
Telebras President Fernando Xavier Ferreira told the newspaper that basic service would rise to 11.22 reais a month from 3.74 reais now.
The rate hike was expected to come in November.
Ferreira said the increase was part of a plan to reduce the company's current "cross subsidy" system where below market charges for basic service are financed by more expensive international service.
